add_nodes.summary: The remaining concrete high-capacity cheap route is the target-blind CP1536 H128/P4/C256 width-equivariant recurrent observer already literally metered at 209,904,700,250 FLOPs but never trained or scored. It is materially different from the failed scalar RFF and local/tree students.
add_nodes.terminal_criterion: Under network-grouped observer_fit cross-validation with observer_selection sealed, train the frozen H128/P4/C256 architecture and require finite autonomous final raw MSE <1e-7; if its teacher-forced/local capacity cannot approach 1e-7, stop before full recurrent training and close that exact form.
